tips.text: Pull Deimos Infested onto the Predasite and wait for its name to read Weakened; your own damage never counts.
Tranq the Predasite first, then bring the Infested to it.
Throw a Pherliac Pod onto the sleeping Predasite so nearby Infested converge and attack it.
Walk up and collect the Predasite once its health hits zero; Infested cannot actually kill it.
Bring invisibility such as Ivara so Infested go for the Predasite, and skip Archwing boosting, which disrupts spawns.
Expect one Fass cycle to be plenty once you know the Weakened trick; the usual confusion is tags that are not pets.
Players grumble about the Entrati standing and the Rank 3 gate more than the capture.
